assumptions: All illustrations original schematics, not actual cell geometry, photon/atom colours, measurements or calibrated timing. Gold wavy arrows represent energy transfer, blue dots carbon matter. Energy is not a kind of atom.

EnergyRelay compares representative toast/body and leaf/plant routes. Food digestion/absorption/circulation and carbon retained in biomass are explained, not quantified. One respired carbon path can return to CO2; not every carbon atom instantly returns. Other chemical-energy-supported ecosystems acknowledged.

Photosynthesis uses shared plantSugar qualitative prerequisites: representative viable mesophyll chloroplasts, suitable enzymes/temperature and available materials, with no reserve sustaining the depicted sugar-making route when prerequisites are absent. Light values 0/1/2 do not compute a rate, yield or high-light response. No net photosynthesis-minus-respiration quantity is calculated. When usable CO2 is supplied, six carbon tracer identities are retained; without usable CO2 no carbon tracers are supplied; hydrogen/oxygen intermediates omitted, water/oxygen icons not molecule counts, sugar point cluster not a structural formula. Actual sugars arise through multi-step pathways.

Respiration profiles represent mesophyll, root and muscle with existing usable sugar and suitable other conditions. Day/night does not switch aerobic respiration off; only depicted oxygen absence removes the aerobic route. Cytoplasmic initial steps and mitochondrial later steps distinguished. Missing oxygen does not imply no ATP from reserves or glycolysis/fermentation-related pathways. No ATP count, death time or real rate predicted.

FoodEnergy uses initial plant organic chemical energy 1000 invented E units, not incident sunlight. Two feeding links share an assumed transfer fraction 5/10/20%, not universal measured efficiency. Each level assigns 20% to detritus and the remainder after transfer to eventual heat after respiration/work; terminal predator has no onward feeder. Input = onward + detritus + heat at each level; summed heat and retained detritus = 1000E. Detritus still contains chemical energy; decomposition rate/time not calculated. All energy bars share one zero-based scale. Neither bars nor budget predict organism count/size/population.

Carbon view represents possible atmospheric CO2→plant organic matter→feeding/detritus→respiration→CO2 routes, not a full carbon inventory or a guarantee for every atom. Decomposers link multiple levels. New photosynthesis needs new energy input; dispersed heat is not recycled into sunlight. No chemical experiments, breath-holding, diet ranking or changed plant care.
